Priya (People Ops): Quick note: orientation moved to Wed 9:30 AM PT / 5:30 PM GMT because of a calendar conflict. I updated the invite and resent to new-hires. Zoom link in event.
Marco: Got the update but my calendar still shows the old time. Do I need to decline and accept again?
Priya (People Ops): If your client didn't auto-update, please decline the old event and accept the new one. I also sent an updated .ics for Outlook users.
Yuna: I'm JST, 9:30 AM PT = 1:30 AM JST, so won't make it live. Will there be an APAC repeat or just recording?
Priya (People Ops): We'll run a short APAC-friendly live run-through next Friday at 7:00 AM PT / 11:00 PM JST and post the main recording to Notion. I'll add jump timestamps and captions.
Marco: Any chance we can add the onboarding buddy and the Slack handle to the event description? Makes quick follow-ups easier.
Priya (People Ops): Yep adding buddy assignments and Slack handles now. Also putting the MFA + access checklist links in the description.
IT-bot: Reminder: complete SSO + MFA before attending. See https://intranet.company.com/it/onboarding for steps.
Yuna: Thanks. Can calendar-bot confirm the recording location when available?
calendar-bot: Meeting updated: "New Hire Orientation (rescheduled)" Wed 2025-03-19 09:30:00 PT. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/4444444444. Recording will be posted to https://drive.company.com/orientation-recordings and linked in the event.
Marco: Confirmed and accepted the new invite. Thanks Priya.
Priya (People Ops): Great — reminder email will go out 1 hour before the session with the checklist. If anyone still has calendar issues, DM me and I'll send a direct invite in your timezone.
Yuna: Appreciate it :pray:
